:::{#def-precision-matrix}
#### Precision matrix

Let $\vX$ be a $p \times 1$ [multivariate Gaussian](#def-mvn) vector.
The **precision matrix** $\precision(\vX)$ of $\vX$ is the $p \times p$ [matrix](https://morrison-lab.github.io/mds/linear-algebra-matrices.html#def-matrix)
whose $i$th [diagonal](https://morrison-lab.github.io/mds/linear-algebra-matrices.html#def-diagonal-entry) element is the [conditional precision](#def-conditional-precision) of $X_i$ given $\vX_{-i}$,
and whose $(i, j)$ element, for $i \ne j$, is the [coprecision](#def-coprecision) of $X_i$ and $X_j$ given $\vX_{-ij}$.

:::
